sentence: After a failed production deploy of a service, block further production deploys of that service until a rollback has completed.
other_comments: Kylie's gate records a failed tool call as an `error` event, and a finished rollback as a `response` event.

sentence: No more than $1,000 may be refunded in a single day.
approximation: Dogwood windows slide; "a day" is read as the last 24h.
other_comments: Sums REQUEST amounts (incl. this one) so parallel calls cannot slip past.

sentence: Never refund the same order twice.
approximation: history is capped at 24h by default, so this only catches a repeat within the last 24h.
other_comments: A `response` event means the refund went through (failures are `error` events).

sentence: Refunds are only allowed for orders placed within the last 30 days.
dogwood:
forbid (principal, action == Shop::Action::"IssueRefund", resource)
when { context.input.order_age_days > 30 };

sentence: A production deploy needs an approval for that same service, version and environment, granted within the last 2 hours.
reason: Needs a `RequestDeployApproval` tool (input service/version/env, output approved). As a permit it would also have to be merged with R6 into ONE prod-deploy permit (two permits would OR, letting either one alone through).
